question: give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc_rates AS (SELECT district, year, (anc4_completed * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) * 100 AS anc_rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc_rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc_rate END) AS percentage_point_increase FROM anc_rates GROUP BY district

CURRENT QUESTION:
give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
attempts.response:
WITH anc_rates AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    (anc4_completed * 1.0 / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) * 100 AS anc_rate
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
)
SELECT
  district,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN anc_rate END) -
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN anc_rate END) AS percentage_point_increase
FROM anc_rates
GROUP BY district;
